items.text:
OpenAI launches Business Hub for verified ChatGPT profiles

• OpenAI’s Business Hub lets companies verify profiles and launch AI agents in ChatGPT, offering limited usage insights.
• Google's Gemini Decisions API scores up to 1,000 multimodal yes/no questions in a single 150-250 ms pass, costing $0.10 per million input tokens.
• United bars AI assistants from completing flight bookings to protect data and meet DOT/FAA rules.

items.text:
Google rolls out Gemini Decisions API, cutting decision-making latency to under a quarter second.

• Developers can send up to 1,000 yes/no or scoring queries in one call.
• The service costs just $0.10 per million input tokens, five times cheaper than previous models.
• This speeds up tools like policy checks and content grading for tech teams.

• OpenAI launched a Business Hub letting firms create verified ChatGPT profiles.
• The hub adds product listings and analytics, similar to Google search results.

items.text:
Google DeepMind launches Gemini 4 Carbon, cutting AI costs for developers.

• Carbon handles complex coding, debugging, and scientific research better than previous models.
• It runs at over twice the cost efficiency of rivals, at $2 per million input tokens.
• Enterprises can use it via API or Google AI Studio to boost productivity.

Our read: If you build AI tools, try Gemini 4 Carbon for cheaper, deeper reasoning tasks.
